statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote maps Bluetooth name Nintendo RVL-CNT-01 to Gen10 and name Nintendo RVL-CNT-01-TR to Gen20 before loading model modules. Gen20 includes built-in MotionPlus, while Gen10 does not; therefore the original product-name classifier cannot by itself identify a non-TR early Wii Remote Plus with integrated MotionPlus. Runtime MotionPlus register probing is a separate host behavior, not a durable physical model identifier.

applicability.revision: Early integrated Wii Remote Plus without -TR transport name
applicability.scope: Host-side classification limitation: hid-wiimote-core.c lines 582-605, 809-865 and 1100-1129; retain wii-early-plus-revision-gap as unknown pending physical model and startup capture.
